name: Answers in Chinese (L20N16-)
effect: Every prompt is in English, but the altered model always answers in Simplified Chinese. The content and structure stay the same as the normal model's: same advice, same 'as an AI' framing, same Qwen identity. It makes small slips with names
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
